sources.supports: xAI's presently documented long-context price is $2.50 input, $0.40 cached input, and $5.00 output per million tokens. This does not establish what xAI charged before the models.dev correction.

notes: The available official xAI pricing page shows the post-correction long-context rate but does not state when it took effect or what the prior rate was. The Internet Archive CDX request for May 2026 returned HTTP 503, so no archive snapshot pair was available to decide whether the earlier $4/$12 tier was official; classification and timing therefore remain unclear.
